fields.hero_prompt: Build airline survey questions my regional airline sends after each flight lands, with one rating per stage and every answer saved by flight number.

faq_plan.q: How do I create airline survey questions?

plan.angle: The top 10 are template libraries that list 6 to 39 airline survey questions grouped by booking, airport, cabin, delays and bags. This page shows the same questions as a working survey: one rating per stage of the trip, delay questions only for passengers whose flight landed late, baggage questions only for passengers whose bag was late, every answer tagged with the flight number and route, and four airline uses that include route research before a ticket is sold.
tab_stories: Thistlewood Air sends its post-flight survey after each landing with one rating per stage, and on flight TW 418 from Denver to Boise 96 of 142 passengers answered and 31 named boarding the worst stage, so station manager Thandie Vesper moved the gate to zone boarding.

Harrow Bay Airlines adds 3 delay questions for any flight that lands 15 minutes or more late, and after flight HB 227 landed 2 hours 10 minutes late, 33 of the 54 passengers who answered said they first heard about the delay at the gate, so ops lead Gideon Strand moved the delay text earlier.

Kittredge Air surveys each passenger whose bag arrived late once the bag is delivered, and when Ines Rotherwood rates the delivery 1 out of 5 because the bag went to the wrong hotel, baggage lead Tobias Fenn gets a Slack message with her file number.

Brightridge Air asks loyalty members in Tucson which of 4 new nonstop routes they would book, and 512 of the 1,240 who answered pick Portland, so network planner Nerys Halloran puts Portland on the spring schedule.
